rule_or_requirement: A fast pixel-only driver needs to preserve valid completion by learning when to coast as well as when to boost.
observable_information: Successful TRAIN stable-driver pixel observations, inherited actions and shadow geometry-teacher boost/hold/coast advice; validation labels remain within TRAIN.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Collect shadow labels without executing teacher actions, train one three-class pixel model, and save a tensor-only checkpoint; no driving policy evaluation in this run.
expected_success_endpoint: At least fifty coast training labels, ten coast validation labels, ten confident predicted coasts, validation coast precision at least 0.60 and recall at least 0.20, finite losses and pixel-only inference contract.
control: Unchanged stable-risk pixel driver over selected full-road-guard checkpoint; teacher advice is shadow only and all collection episodes are TRAIN identities.
falsifier: No meaningful coast class support or prediction, nonfinite loss, teacher action execution, or privileged simulator input at student inference.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Twelve stable-driver TRAIN rollouts on tracks 1–3 × seeds 5016–5019, successful rows only, with seed 5019 held for within-TRAIN validation.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU training profile capped at 1,800 seconds and 2,000 decisions per episode; no TUNE or external action.
